summary.headline: Siyaram Silk Q1 FY27 total income rose 16.4% to INR466 crores, EBITDA up 22.3% to INR40 crores at 8.6% margin, PAT INR11 crores.
summary.overview: Standalone total income grew 16.4% YoY to INR466 crores, with fabrics at 71% of revenue, garments 19% and yarn & others 10%. EBITDA rose 22.3% to INR40 crores, margin 8.6%, and PAT more than doubled to INR11 crores (PAT margin 2.4%) on operating leverage. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of ~12% revenue growth and ~14% EBITDA margin including retail, with a ~150 bps EBITDA drag from ZECODE and DEVO. Adhik Maas moderated wedding demand in the quarter, and Diwali is expected to be ~3 weeks later this year.

financial_highlights.change: Mostly recurring (delayed interest, rent); ~30% is mark-to-market gain
FY27 expectation ~INR160 crores vs ~INR70-80 crores in FY26

segments.name: Fabrics
segments.commentary: Contributed 71% of Q1 FY27 revenue. No separate segment margin or growth figure disclosed on the call.

segments.name: Garments
segments.commentary: Contributed 19% of Q1 FY27 revenue. No separate growth or margin figure disclosed.

segments.name: Yarn & Others

segments.name: Retail (ZECODE and DEVO)
segments.commentary: Store count at 30 ZECODE and 19 DEVO after adding 3 and 2 stores in Q1; target ~70 stores across both in FY27. Q1 revenue ~INR30 crores; FY27 revenue target ~INR160 crores; EBITDA drag guided at ~150 bps annually.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance (including retail): ~12% revenue growth and ~14% EBITDA margin, reiterated by management.
Retail drag on annual EBITDA margin guided at ~150 bps; management said it expects to be well within that budget. Stated as a ballpark, including all store costs (rent included per management).
ZECODE store profitability expected in 1.5 to 2 years; some ZECODE stores already EBITDA positive, including some under one year old.
FY27 capex about INR100 crores, of which INR40-50 crores for retail; management expects positive free cash flow to remain this year.
Store expansion to accelerate only after business predictability and proof of mature store model; ~70 stores targeted in FY27, funded by internal accruals.
Real estate project (land development): construction expected to start in Q1 FY27, 24-month completion; no revenue booked yet.
capex_capacity: ZECODE and DEVO network: 30 and 19 stores at quarter end after adding 3 and 2 in Q1; ~25-30 stores in total as of June per management.
Average ZECODE store size moved from ~4,000 sq ft high-street formats to ~7,000 sq ft, which management says performs better.
FY27 capex ~INR100 crores, with INR40-50 crores for retail; management said spend is not a concern given positive surplus cash flow.
Real estate: INR24.6 crores of land development cost passed through P&L with an equal reversal from inventory (net nil); 24-month construction timeline.
Franchise model considered an option later but not pursued; company is using internal capital for stores.
demand_pricing: Demand stable in Q1 but wedding and occasion-led purchases moderated during Adhik Maas; consumers value-conscious and input-cost inflation persisted.
Diwali pushed back about 3 weeks this year, which management expects to delay demand; management said sentiment for the season is positive.
Some price pass-on taken in Q1, and further pass-on planned gradually if raw material costs stay high; management said raw material inflation is volatile and cannot be fully passed through.
ZECODE targets Gen Z in Karnataka/Bangalore first; fast fashion described as a large, faster-growing market with many competitors.
Asset-light, rotating inventory model lets the company shift quickly between categories; working capital build is seasonal ahead of festive and wedding seasons.

qa_highlights.question: How are ZECODE store profitability and breakeven tracking amid competition?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said stores are ~18 months old and profitability is targeted in 1.5-2 years; some stores are EBITDA positive, including some under a year old, but it is too early to conclude.

qa_highlights.question: How much EBITDA loss does retail carry and is the 150 bps drop inclusive of rent?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the ~150 bps annual EBITDA drop is a ballpark that includes all store operating costs and rent; it is not measured quarterly and the company will not disclose separate ZECODE/DEVO numbers yet.

qa_highlights.question: What drives the Q1 margin improvement, excluding the INR24-25 crore land development cost?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the land cost was moved from inventory to expenses, so the net effect is nil and EBITDA margins are unchanged; the quarter should not be modelled alone given seasonality.

qa_highlights.question: What is the retail revenue outlook and what would trigger faster store expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Retail revenue was ~INR30 crores in Q1 with FY27 at ~INR160 crores; management will accelerate expansion only after store maturity and scale in infrastructure and technology.

qa_highlights.question: How is raw material inflation expected to affect margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said some pass-on was taken in Q1 with more possible if margins compress, and it reiterated the ~14% EBITDA margin guidance including the retail drag.

qa_highlights.question: Is other income one-off?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said other income is mostly recurring (delayed payment interest, rent); management said about 30% is a mark-to-market gain that varies quarter to quarter.

risks_watch: Retail EBITDA drag (~150 bps) depends on store maturity; ZECODE profitability not yet proven and DEVO performance untested beyond the festive season.
Working capital: inventory and receivables built in March; management says March-to-March comparison is the right gauge and extra inventory will rise with store count.
Raw material and chemical cost volatility, with pass-through to customers only partial.
Diwali delayed about 3 weeks, which could shift festive revenue between Q2 and Q3.
Other income includes mark-to-market gains that could reverse in later quarters.
Preference share bonus issue: record date 22 August 2026; tax treatment for investors not settled and listing/sale treatment still to be confirmed.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the core business and annual guidance, but evasive on retail economics: management declined to quantify store losses or disclose ZECODE/DEVO figures, calling the sample too small. Cautious on quarterly reads, repeatedly pointing to annual and March-to-March comparisons.
key_quotes: For some of the stores that we've opened, we have seen very positive results, and I've indicated earlier that some stores have turned EBITDA positive, but it's too early to come to those conclusions.

We are very positive on reaching the guidance that we had indicated.
It's better to look at March to March numbers.
So it's not a function of being 1 year old. It's just a function of the whole model coming together and us learning from this experience and moving forward.

growth.why: Management reiterated ~12% FY27 revenue growth (incl. retail) and ~14% EBITDA margin, with retail revenue targeted at ~INR160 crore vs ~INR70-80 crore in FY26 and ~70 stores planned; Q1 total income already rose 16.4% YoY, but no utilisation figure was given and demand moderated during Adhik Maas.
